excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, long black hair, Asian ethnicity. Uniform: A yellow tee shirt with a unicorn image worn UNDER a white lab coat, yellow skirt and white sneakers.
excavation_context.stage: Air-Scribing Limestone Matrix in a Desert Basecamp

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_6, an adult female grad student with braided black hair, wears a white lab coat over a yellow unicorn tee shirt and yellow skirt. She is crouched at an outdoor table at a desert field camp, using a pneumatic air scribe to meticulously remove cream-white limestone matrix from a small, completely intact Compsognathus skeleton. Background shows canvas field tents, equipment cases, and other team members sifting sediment under a bright midday sun. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
